verdict.rationale: HumanLayer orchestrates coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. A user can paste images (e.g., a mockup) into a new task, pick a Oneshot or PRD-Oriented workflow, and have the agent open a draft PR. That plausibly covers the path from design input to implementation. However, nothing documents a design- or mockup-to-code flow, and the setup (workspaces, repos, hosts) and review model are aimed at engineers rather than a PM working without handoff. Missing for 10: an explicit mockup/design-to-implementation workflow, design-tool integration (e.g., Figma), evidence that non-engineers can complete the flow end to end without engineering review, and hands-on corroboration.
